content.text: Digital creators face significant challenges when trying to sell their products online, particularly in regions where platforms like PayPal and Stripe are unavailable or heavily restricted. In these situations, relying on traditional payment gateways can limit your ability to reach customers and retain profits. This post explains how crypto payment gateways can empower creators to sell digital products without the high fees and restrictions of conventional platforms. If you’re [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-digital-products-without-stripe-which-architecture-actually-24|COREMERCH guide to selling]] ebooks, courses, or templates, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/understanding-selling-online-without-gumroad-plain-language-infrastructure-3|understanding]] this [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-19|The Real]] is essential for financial independence.

For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-explained-digital-creators-6. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Crypto payment

A crypto payment gateway is a service that facilitates the acceptance of cryptocurrency as a payment method for digital products. Unlike traditional payment processors, which often charge high transaction fees and impose strict regulations, crypto gateways like NOWPayments charge just 0.5%. This difference can significantly impact your bottom line. For instance, on a $97 product, selling 100 items per month means you retain $921 more with a crypto gateway than you would with a platform like Gumroad that charges 10% per sale. This infrastructure allows you to maximize your revenue while ensuring instant payment confirmation and full ownership of your sales data.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of a crypto payment gateway involves several components working together seamlessly. At its core, it utilizes a backend service like Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to handle payment processing and order management. When a customer makes a purchase with cryptocurrency, the payment is verified on the blockchain using NOWPayments, ensuring security and transparency. Once the payment is confirmed, automated scripts deliver the digital product directly to the customer. This system not only automates delivery but also minimizes delays, creating a smooth transaction experience for both the seller and the buyer.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators in regions where conventional payment platforms are inaccessible. Whether you’re a course creator in Nigeria, an ebook author in Venezuela, or a graphic designer in Zimbabwe, you can leverage this system to sell your products directly to customers without relying on third-party platforms. The architecture supports various digital products, including templates, plugins, and software, enabling you to maintain complete control over your sales process. By choosing this solution, you position yourself to succeed in a global marketplace without the barriers imposed by traditional financial systems.
Pay only 0.5% in fees with NOWPayments versus 10% with traditional platforms.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The complete architecture consists of several key components: a hosting platform like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, which provides a free online presence; backend logic via Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for payment handling; and a storage solution like Supabase or Google Sheets for order management. For product delivery, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 can be used efficiently. All these elements integrate smoothly with NOWPayments, allowing you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies. This combination not only reduces costs but also provides a robust and scalable solution for digital creators.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To start deploying your own sovereign digital commerce stack, begin by selecting the right hosting platform, such as GitHub Pages. Next, set up your backend logic using Google Apps Script to manage payment confirmations and product deliveries. Integrate NOWPayments for seamless cryptocurrency transactions. Store your orders in a platform like Supabase, and use Google Drive for file delivery. Finally, ensure you load your product offerings into the system. For those seeking a comprehensive solution, consider the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for all the blueprints and templates you need to build, deploy, and scale your online store quickly.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Automate delivery and maintain full control over your sales process.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

If you're looking to sell digital downloads without platform fees, explore options like the Complete Builder Kit ($197) available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html. This kit provides everything needed to build an efficient and sovereign digital commerce stack, empowering you to operate independently.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I set up a crypto payment gateway?

To set up a crypto payment gateway, select a provider like NOWPayments. Create an account, generate API keys, and configure it in your backend logic. Ensure you also set up product delivery mechanisms to automate the process for your customers.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?

With NOWPayments, you can accept over 300 cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT, and more. This flexibility allows you to cater to a wider audience and take advantage of various crypto markets.
Can I automate product delivery?

Yes, you can automate product delivery using tools like Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers. Once a payment is confirmed, these tools can trigger the delivery of your digital products instantly to the customer.
Is there a fee for using crypto payment gateways?
NOWPayments charges a fee of only 0.5% per transaction, which is significantly lower than traditional payment platforms that often charge around 10%. This means you keep more of your earnings.
How can I ensure my customers receive their purchases?

By integrating your payment gateway with automated delivery systems, you can ensure that customers receive their purchases immediately after payment confirmation. This system improves customer satisfaction and reduces the chance of disputes.
